note: The verifier's pins for TEE scores. The only accepted build is scorer v2, the canonical build: tee/build-docker.sh (Linux x86_64 in a digest-pinned Rust image), which gives the same bytes on macOS through Docker and on Linux. It supports request templates v1 and v2 (seal-bound nonces) and never echoes a sealed value in an error. Scorer v1 (a848254b9d2cda2ca522e839b4e4f7de33ec1d51a364fb9a0d92d88f252f69a7, tee/build.sh at commit f9bbbe9, reproducible on macOS arm64 only) was retired on 2026-11-05 after all six of its scores were re-done with v2.

scorers.build: scorer v2: tee/build-docker.sh (canonical; reproduced natively on Linux x86_64 with the container's paths)
